scope: Read-only relay HTTP409/recovery and Android direct-download verification proposal

normalApi.behavior: success() reads a bounded error JSON body, accepts only STATION_[A-Z0-9_]{1,80}, never exposes the response body, and throws Failure(status,code,retryAfter)
normalApi.diagnosticsLimit: Only four download categories retain a named event; all other codes become SERVER_OTHER_FAILURE
normalApi.roomsBehavior: recordFailure logs HTTP status and bounded uppercase safe Failure.code, exception class and bounded stack frames, without exception text or body

relayWebsocket.behavior: The first response line rejects every status except 101 at line168 before response headers and JSON body are read
relayWebsocket.dispatchBehavior: InvalidHandshakeException closes with its WebSocket protocol close code and exception reason. It is not delivered as StationApi.Failure
relayWebsocket.tunnelBehavior: onClose logs epoch, WebSocket close code and peer flag; onError logs exception class. Both call lost(). Neither logs reason, HTTP status or JSON code
relayWebsocket.legacyBehavior: The v2 recovery tunnel has the same diagnostic limitation

existingRecovery.behavior: lost clears the current transport and welcome/READY notification state, pauses native transport, shows waiting and requests a fresh ticket after bounded 2/4/8/10-second backoff. The 250-ms scheduler checks deadlines; there is no spin retry and no special branch for HTTP409 JSON codes
existingRecovery.ticketCommandTerminalBehavior: License denial, 404, and explicit generation/unrecoverable/game/profile/membership error codes terminate the ticket owner. Other ticket command errors use the existing unavailable/backoff path

futureMinimalCaptureProposal.preferred: In a separately authorized server diagnostic change, record one structured bounded safe status/code event at the existing RelayError boundary, where the internally generated error code is already known. Include route category, UTC and existing generated trace/correlation only. Keep request headers, grant/ticket, proof, query, full URI, identity, payload, raw exception text and body out of the event
futureMinimalCaptureProposal.advantages: No APK/native identity change, no rejected-handshake body parser, no changes to auth/admission/recovery/READY
futureMinimalCaptureProposal.minimumAppAlternativeLimitation: The current parser discards the body before relay callbacks. Capturing JSON code on Android would need a separate carefully bounded diagnostic transport/parser change; logging onClose reason alone only recovers an HTTP status line, not the safe code
futureMinimalCaptureProposal.nextTest: Keep separate per-device/private logs and backend safe diagnostic events for the next ordinary game start. Correlate windows, not millisecond ordering across unsynchronized hosts. Do not assert stale lease/duplicate attachment from HTTP409 alone

androidDirectDownloadProposal.selection: One small legitimately authorized item already available in the normal signed catalog and existing user license; initiate through the app UI
functionalEvidence: Private bounded StationService logs: AUTHORIZE, ARTIFACT headers, DOWNLOAD elapsed/bytes and INSTALL_FINISHED
UI completion and announced/received size; cancellation only if independently needed
Existing transfer contract performs size, MIME, cancellation and staging/atomic publication checks; do not enable the previously disabled Android content hashing merely to test routing

routeSourceEvidence.behavior: Only canonical grant GET uses downloads-station.lzgames.com.br and its dedicated system-CA-plus-SPKI socket factory. Authorization/catalog/profile/cover/online endpoints keep the original origin. Hostname validation and redirect refusal remain enabled. Timeouts remain10s/30s. No Range, fallback, concurrency or retry change

destinationObservation.possibleExistingBackendEvidence: Only if the existing private request journal actually contains the dedicated Host and the same generated correlation for this transfer; do not assume it does
destinationObservation.possibleNormalAndroidEvidence: A read-only system socket observation with proven package UID, peerIP and time window may identify the actual direct destination if normal shell permissions/tool availability permit it. Generic byte counters or an unowned socket do not prove host. No permissions bypass if denied
destinationObservation.withoutDestinationEvidence: Report successful normal Android download plus source-selected dedicated route; do not claim direct WAN traffic independently proven
